rules.constraint: Keep secrets out of source, plans and logs.
rules.task: Use placeholders and existing secret configuration.
rules.acceptance: A fake secret stays out of changed public outputs; valid config works.
rules.verification: Check changed outputs with a fake secret; record results.

rules.constraint: Preserve protections; avoid blind dependency upgrades.
rules.task: Review changed dependencies/config and dev/production differences.
rules.acceptance: Changes preserve required behavior; unresolved advisories are recorded.
rules.verification: Review lock/config diff and run relevant existing checks.
